title: The finite-coefficient Verdier dual over a field has constructible cohomology
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring whose additive exponent is invertible in $k$. Use the ordinary derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme with structure morphism $a:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, compactifiable by [thm-nagata-compactification]. Let $a^\times$ be the right adjoint of $Ra_!$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], put $\omega_T=a^\times\Lambda$ and $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,\omega_T)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then $\omega_T$ is bounded with constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and for every bounded complex $K$ with constructible cohomology sheaves, $D_TK$ lies in $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ and all its cohomology sheaves are constructible.

source.place: 4.1 and 4.2.4 (D_X of a constructible complex is constructible over a field)

proof.text: Both assertions are local on $T$: for an open immersion $v:V\hookrightarrow T$, $v^*\omega_T\cong\omega_V$ by [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], and derived internal Hom commutes with this restriction by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. Constructibility glues over a finite open cover by restricting each chart's strata to $V_j\setminus\bigcup_{h<j}V_h$; bounds glue by taking the minimum lower and maximum upper bound. Apply [lem-sf-affine-chart-factorization-gluing] to $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$: it supplies a finite affine cover whose members embed as closed subschemes of affine spaces over $k$. Work on one such member; the empty scheme is immediate.

proof.text: Write $i:T\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf A^n_k$, $p:P\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $h:P\setminus T\hookrightarrow P$. Composition of compact supports [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and uniqueness of right adjoints identify $a^\times\cong Ri^!p^\times$, where $Ri^!$ is the right adjoint of closed direct image [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Affine-space adjunction [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction] identifies $p^\times\Lambda$ with $M=\Lambda_P(n)[2n]$. This is bounded constructible: the twist is finite locally constant of rank one by [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], applied with the positive additive exponent of $\Lambda$. For any bounded constructible $M$, [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle] gives $i_*Ri^!M\to M\to Rh_*h^*M\to$. The third term is bounded constructible by [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility], so the long cohomology sequence and [thm-constructible-serre] give the same for the first. Closed direct image here is termwise and exact; $i^*i_*\cong1$ follows from [lem-kun-04ca], also for module sheaves since its unit and counit respect scalar actions. Restriction of each finite stratification to $T$ is a finite stratification. Thus $Ri^!M$ is bounded constructible, and the choice $M=\Lambda_P(n)[2n]$ proves the assertion for $\omega_T$. Step 1 proves it for every separated finite-type $T$.

source.place: §§2.2.12–2.2.13 and 4.0: finite-coefficient constructibility and duality background; the affine-space route is the human route decision of 2026-10-19

proof.text:
Choose $r,c$ with $K\in D^{\le r}$ and $\omega_T\in D^{\ge c}$. The lower bound in [lem-per-bounded-above-rhom-hyperext] gives $D_TK\in D^{\ge c-r}$. For constructibility, the finite truncation tower of $K$ [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles], preservation of triangles by internal Hom [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction], and [thm-constructible-serre] reduce to a constructible sheaf $G$. Its finite filtration in [lem-fin-constructible-devissage] reduces further to $G=c_*u_!L$ for $S\xrightarrow{u}\overline S\xrightarrow{c}T$ (open into the closure, then closed) and a lisse finite $\Lambda$-sheaf $L$ on $S$. Put $U=T\setminus(\overline S\setminus S)$, open, so $S=\overline S\cap U$ is closed in $U$; write $s:S\xrightarrow{i}U\xrightarrow{j}T$. Closed direct image commutes with restriction to $U$, so $j^{-1}G\cong i_*L$, and $G$ has zero stalks off $U$; hence the counit $j_!j^{-1}G\to G$ is an isomorphism and $G\cong j_!i_*L=Rs_!L$ in the convention of [lem-weil-stratum-ambient-hom]. The sheafified adjunction [lem-weil-stratum-ambient-hom], in its ordinary etale case, gives
$$R\mathcal Hom(Rs_!L,\omega_T)\cong Rs_*R\mathcal Hom(L,Rs^!\omega_T).$$
Composition of compact supports [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and uniqueness of right adjoints identify $Rs^!\omega_T$ with $\omega_S$, bounded constructible by Step 2 and Step 1. Every $S$ is separated and finite type over $k$.

source.place: §§2.2.12–2.2.13 and 4.0: finite-coefficient constructibility and duality background; the affine-space route is the human route decision of 2026-10-19

proof.text: We check $N=R\mathcal Hom(L,\omega_S)$ has constructible cohomology. Etale locally $L$ is constant with value a finite $\Lambda$-module $L_0$. The finite ring $\Lambda$ is Noetherian (its ideals form a finite set), so [lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-resolution-noetherian] gives a resolution $P^\bullet\to L_0$ with $P^i$ finite free and $P^i=0$ for $i>0$. For a constructible sheaf $F$, [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-site-bounded-free-rhom-model] applied to $P^\bullet$ and $F[0]$ represents $R\mathcal Hom(L_0,F)$ by a complex whose degree $q\ge0$ term is a finite sum of copies of $F$ and whose negative terms vanish. Its kernels, images and cokernels are constructible by [thm-constructible-serre]; hence all $\mathcal Ext^q(L_0,F)$ are constructible. Now apply [lem-per-bounded-above-rhom-hyperext] with $K=L_0$, $r=0$, and $L=\omega_S\in D^{\ge c}$. Its $E_2$ terms are the just-proved constructible Ext sheaves. Each total degree has a finite abutment filtration, and each term stabilizes after finitely many pages because $p\ge0$, $q\ge c$. Kernels, cokernels and extensions therefore make its abutment constructible. Internal Hom restriction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] identifies these local calculations with $N$. Choose finitely many affine etale trivializing charts covering the quasi-compact scheme $S$. Their disjoint union is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so [lem-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-surjective-pullback] both preserves constructibility of the target cohomology on these charts and descends the computed cohomology sheaves to $S$. Also $N\in D^+$ by the same lower bound.

proof.text:
Finally let $N\in D^{\ge c}(S,\Lambda)$ have constructible cohomology, as in Step 4. For every $q$, $\tau^{\le q}N$ is bounded constructible. A bounded-below injective resolution of $\tau^{\ge q+1}N$ can be chosen zero in degrees at most $q$; its termwise direct image is still zero in those degrees. Applying $Rs_*$ to the truncation triangle thus gives
$$\mathcal H^q(Rs_*N)\cong\mathcal H^q(Rs_*\tau^{\le q}N).$$
The latter is constructible by [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility], with the same finite coefficient ring and the finite-type schemes $S,T$ over $k$. Combine this with Step 3 and the kernel, cokernel and extension closure [thm-constructible-serre] along its finite truncation and sheaf-filtration towers. Every cohomology sheaf of $D_TK$ is constructible, as required.
